name: Object Ownership Validation
description: Ensure every resource access is validated against the requesting user's ownership or permission.
implementation_guidance: Add ownership check in every GET/PUT/DELETE endpoint using user_id from JWT claim. Return 403 if mismatch.

name: HMAC Webhook Signature Verification
description: Verify incoming webhook payloads using HMAC-SHA256 signature.
implementation_guidance: Compare X-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of raw body using shared secret) before processing webhook. Include nonce and timestamp to prevent replay.

name: Server-Side Amount/Value Calculation
description: Never trust client-submitted financial or critical values. Always recalculate on the server.
implementation_guidance: Retrieve price/amount from authoritative source (DB or pricing service) server-side. Ignore or validate client-submitted values.

name: PII Data Minimization and Masking
description: Only collect, process, and expose the minimum PII required. Mask sensitive fields in responses and logs.
implementation_guidance: Remove unnecessary PII from API responses. Mask phone numbers (e.g. +62812****1234). Filter PII from log output.

name: Nonce and Timestamp Validation
description: Prevent replay attacks by validating request freshness and uniqueness.
implementation_guidance: Include timestamp in signed payload. Reject requests older than 5 minutes. Store and check nonce for uniqueness within time window.

name: Server-Side RBAC / ABAC
description: Enforce role-based or attribute-based access control on every API endpoint server-side.
implementation_guidance: Validate user roles/permissions from JWT or session on every request. Do not rely on client-side role checks.

name: Immutable Audit Log
description: Log all critical actions in an append-only, tamper-evident audit trail.
implementation_guidance: Use append-only log storage. Log: user ID, action, resource ID, timestamp, IP. Do not allow log deletion via application API.

name: Log Masking and PII Filtering
description: Prevent PII and sensitive data from being written to application logs.
implementation_guidance: Use log middleware to mask known PII patterns (phone, email, card number). Avoid logging raw request bodies for authenticated endpoints.

name: Rate Limiting / Throttling
description: Limit request rate per user/IP to prevent abuse and DoS.
implementation_guidance: Apply rate limiting at API gateway or application level. Use sliding window algorithm. Return 429 with Retry-After header.

name: Input Validation and Sanitization
description: Validate and sanitize all user input before processing.
implementation_guidance: Use allowlist validation on all input fields. Reject unexpected fields. Validate data types, length, and format.

name: Secure Token / JWT Validation
description: Validate JWT signature, expiry, issuer, and audience on every request.
implementation_guidance: Verify JWT signature using asymmetric key. Check exp, iss, aud claims. Maintain token revocation list for sensitive sessions.

name: Encryption in Transit (TLS)
description: Enforce HTTPS/TLS for all data in transit.
implementation_guidance: Enforce HTTPS-only. Use TLS 1.2 minimum. Configure HSTS header. Reject HTTP connections.

name: Data Retention and Deletion Policy
description: Define and enforce data retention periods. Provide user data deletion capability.
implementation_guidance: Implement data TTL for personal data. Provide user data deletion endpoint. Document retention periods per data type.

name: Error Message Sanitization
description: Do not expose internal implementation details in error responses.
implementation_guidance: Return generic error messages to clients. Log detailed error server-side only. Never expose stack traces or SQL errors.

name: Consent and Transparency Mechanism
description: Obtain explicit user consent for data processing. Display clear privacy notice.
implementation_guidance: Show data processing purpose before collection. Store consent records. Provide opt-out mechanism.
